title: The starting point of your new website | Boltcms.io

facts.fact: Bolt 5 was released on 30 August 2021, according to the vendor's release announcement.
facts.quote: We're excited to bring to you the news of the major Bolt 5 release today, 30 August 2021.

facts.fact: The vendor states that Bolt is a Symfony application, so Symfony framework tools can be used in it.
facts.quote: At its core, Bolt is a Symfony application, so you can use the tools provided by the framework.

facts.fact: The vendor states that Bolt provides a RESTful and GraphQL API that needs no extra configuration.
facts.quote: Bolt provides a RESTful and GraphQL API. No extra configuration needed.

facts.fact: The vendor claims that adding more languages to a Bolt site takes one line of code.
facts.quote: Need more languages? No problem, it's just one line of code.

facts.fact: The vendor claims that generating dummy content in Bolt takes a single line of code.
facts.quote: All you need to do is use one single line of code.

facts.fact: The vendor states that the Article and Redactor rich content editors are fully licensed for use in Bolt and free of charge.
facts.quote: Fully licensed for use in Bolt itself. For free.

facts.fact: The vendor states that Bolt's default theme is based on Tailwind.
The vendor states that Bolt's internationalisation allows field-level control over which parts of a page are translated.
facts.quote: With field-level control you can decide exactly which parts of the page will be translated.
